behavioral_effects: New CI job hygiene runs make hygiene (pre-commit over the whole tree with ty and the governance fast check skipped, actionlint, zizmor with .github/zizmor.yml, hadolint over four Dockerfiles) and make secret-scan over the push or PR base range; ci-ok depends on it
Validators hygiene and secret-scan registered with ci_job hygiene; Make targets hygiene, hygiene-precommit, hygiene-workflows, hygiene-dockerfiles, secret-scan added with pinned tool images
All 23 action references in ci.yml pinned to commit SHAs; persist-credentials false on every checkout; the governance --since sha passed via env
backend/Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK uses exec form (hadolint DL3025)
compatibility_impact: make hygiene and make secret-scan need docker for actionlint, hadolint and gitleaks (pinned images) and uv for pre-commit and zizmor. The backend image HEALTHCHECK moved from shell form with || exit 1 to exec form; a connection failure still exits nonzero because httpx raises. backend/.env.example gained its missing final newline.
follow_up: Phase 4: docker matrix over all four images on every event, Trivy JSON evidence, GHCR publish on main and v* tags
limitations: Simplification pass: not run; the change is workflow, Makefile and validator plumbing
Phase 3 of the CI/CD coverage plan. Not here: docker matrix and GHCR publish, e2e, nightly (which will carry the full-history gitleaks scan with a baseline)
reason: The pre-commit configuration was installed on developer machines but never run in CI, so a clone without the hook could commit whatever the hooks would have caught and nobody would know; the workflow files, four Dockerfiles, and commit contents had no linter or secret scan at all, and the repository already carries an open secrets-pushed-to-remote finding. After this change every push and PR runs pre-commit over the whole tree, actionlint and zizmor over the workflows, hadolint over every Dockerfile, and gitleaks over the pushed commit range, and the pre-commit hooks are registered as a validator.
risks: hadolint runs at warning threshold; DL3066 (non-numeric USER) is info-level on all four images and stays visible without gating
Pinned action SHAs go stale without Dependabot; the github-actions ecosystem entry from Phase 1 covers that
rollback: git revert. Nothing lives outside the repository.
security_impact: Positive. Every action in ci.yml is pinned to a commit SHA with its version as a comment (Dependabot keeps them fresh), every checkout sets persist-credentials false, the base sha reaches run steps through env rather than template expansion, and gitleaks now scans every pushed or proposed commit range. zizmor's cache-poisoning audit is accepted in .github/zizmor.yml with the reasoning recorded; the open secrets-pushed-to-remote finding is unchanged - the range scan cannot see history and does not claim to.
summary: Add a hygiene CI job that runs the pre-commit hooks, lints the workflows and Dockerfiles, and scans the pushed range for secrets
